answers.reason: The elected student representative holds no office that grants a seat in the senate.
The budget planning round involves higher office holders and does not provide a seat for the student representative.
The appointment committee is not a body where the student representative has a provided seat.
The elected student representative was elected by the students to speak for them and takes part where regulations provide a seat.
The elected student representative has a seat to represent students in faculty matters such as the study commission.
The examination board decides on individual student matters and does not include the elected student representative as a member.
The internal research funding round is for faculty research grants without student representative participation.
The module revision working group is a lower-level working round without a seat provided for the student representative.
Laboratory equipment procurement is handled without the participation of the elected student representative.
Orientation week planning is open to students as it directly concerns the program of the first week for new students.
